title: TOEIC Preposition Collocation Graded Question Bank

sources.vocabularyCorpus: TOEIC Service List (TSL v1.2, Browne & Culligan, 2016)
sources.phrasalVerbCorpus: British National Corpus (BNC) high-frequency phrasal verb studies (Gardner & Davies, 2007) & Dependent Prepositions grammar references
sources.testAlignment: ETS official public TOEIC Listening & Reading sample test patterns (Parts 3–6)
sources.reliabilityNote: Linguistic collocations and example sentences are verified for standard business English accuracy and unambiguous single-key disambiguation; level tiering (Lv.1–Lv.4) reflects pedagogical curation rather than official ETS frequency rankings.

levels.title: Lv.1 核心固定搭配（目標 450–600 分）
levels.desc: 高頻單一介係詞搭配，建立動詞＋介係詞語塊直覺。

items.example: All staff must comply with the new safety regulations.
items.note: 常與 regulations / policies / guidelines 連用。

items.example: Our support team is trained to deal with urgent complaints.
items.note: 多益聽力與閱讀高頻片語，意近 handle。

items.example: Contractors must abide by the terms of the agreement.
items.note: 語意與 comply with 相近，但介係詞固定為 by。

items.example: Employees are encouraged to participate in the training workshop.
items.note: 同義置換常考 take part in。

items.example: The firm specializes in commercial real estate law.
items.note: 公司介紹與履歷背景常見搭配。

items.example: We rely on regional suppliers for timely deliveries.
items.note: 同義常考 depend on / count on。

items.example: The launch date will depend on the final test results.
items.note: Part 5 常考「視…而定」句型。

items.example: We apologize for any inconvenience caused by the delay.
items.note: apologize to + 人 / apologize for + 事。

items.example: The review committee consists of five senior directors.
items.note: consist of 主動即表「由…組成」，不可寫成 is consisted of。

items.example: Please refrain from using mobile phones during the briefing.
items.note: 公告與信件禮貌禁令極高頻，後接 V-ing。

items.example: Customer service aims to respond to all inquiries within 24 hours.
items.note: 注意與 answer（及物，不加 to）區分。

items.example: Over ten thousand clients subscribe to our monthly newsletter.
items.note: 數位行銷與客服常見搭配。

levels.title: Lv.2 同動詞多義對照組（目標 600–750 分）
levels.desc: 同一動詞換不同介係詞即改變語意，請先辨識括號中文再射擊。

items.example: Candidates may apply for the position online until Friday.
items.note: 對比：apply for (申請) vs. apply to (適用於/向…申請)。

trapHints.to: apply to 指「適用於」或「向某機構申請」；「申請職位」用 apply for！

items.example: The revised travel policy applies to all full-time employees.
items.note: 人資政策與規範條文常見用法。

trapHints.for: apply for 是「申請」；表「規則適用於誰」要用 apply to！

items.example: The event planner is looking for a larger conference venue.
items.note: 對比 look into (調查) 與 look forward to (期待)。

trapHints.into: look into 是「深入調查」；「尋找場地」是 look for！

items.example: Technicians are looking into the cause of the server outage.
items.note: 多益常作為 investigate 的同義置換。

trapHints.for: look for 是「尋找」；「調查原因/問題」用 look into！

items.example: We look forward to meeting your team next Tuesday.
items.note: 此處 to 為介係詞，後方動詞須用 V-ing（如 meeting）。

trapHints.for: 固定片語為 look forward to，不可用 for！

items.example: Automating invoices will result in significant cost savings.
items.note: 因果方向：原因 + result in + 結果。

trapHints.from: result from 是「起因於（原因）」；「導致節省（結果）」用 result in！

items.example: The shipping delay resulted from a labeling error at the warehouse.
items.note: 因果方向：結果 + result from + 原因。

trapHints.in: result in 是「導致（結果）」；「起因於失誤（原因）」用 result from！

items.example: Most board members agree with the CFO's assessment.
items.note: 對象為人、想法或數據結果時用 with。

trapHints.to: agree to 通常接「提案/條件」；同意「某人/意見」用 agree with！

items.example: Both parties agreed to the updated payment schedule.
items.note: 表示接受對方提出的條款、提案或建議。

trapHints.with: 同意「人或想法」用 agree with；接受「條款/計畫」用 agree to！

items.example: The managers finally agreed on a launch date for the product.
items.note: 強調雙方協商後「達成一致決定」。

trapHints.with: 雙方就某事項「達成共識」固定用 agree on！

items.example: The training program consists of four interactive modules.
items.note: 對比 consist in (關鍵在於)。

trapHints.in: consist in 是「在於」；表「由…組成」用 consist of！

items.example: Our competitive edge consists in reliable after-sales service.
items.note: 較進階書面用法，意近 lie in。

trapHints.of: consist of 是「由…組成」；表「關鍵在於…」用 consist in！

levels.title: Lv.3 進階商業與受詞夾心結構（目標 750–900 分）
levels.desc: Verb + A + Prep + B 結構與正式商業搭配（含 2 個干擾球 on / by）。

items.zh: 把 A 歸因於 B
items.meaning: 把 A 歸因於 B
items.example: Analysts attributed the revenue growth to strong overseas demand.
items.note: 多益財報與新聞閱讀高頻結構。

items.example: Every laboratory must adhere to strict quality standards.
items.note: 正式公文用語，比 follow 更正式。

items.example: Several residents objected to extending the parking hours.
items.note: to 為介係詞，後接動名詞 extending。

items.example: Fire doors help prevent smoke from spreading between floors.
items.note: 同型結構：stop / keep / hinder A from V-ing。

items.example: Company rules prohibit staff from sharing client data externally.
items.note: 職場規章考點，常考被動語態 be prohibited from。

items.example: Budget cuts deprived the research unit of essential equipment.
items.note: 極易與 prevent...from 混淆，deprive 固定配 of！

trapHints.from: 小心！prevent 配 from，但 deprive 固定配 of！

items.example: Please dispose of confidential documents using the shredder.
items.note: 名詞為 disposal。

items.example: The airline offered vouchers to compensate for the flight delay.
items.note: 常見被動：be compensated for。

items.example: Online orders now account for sixty percent of total sales.
items.note: 圖表題與財報分析雙義高頻片語。

items.example: Consumers associate this brand with durability and value.
items.note: 常以被動 be associated with 出現。

items.example: All conference rooms are equipped with high-speed Wi-Fi.
items.note: 辦公設施公告極常考 be equipped with。

items.example: The firm plans to invest in automated warehouse systems.
items.note: 名詞 investment 同樣常搭配 in。

levels.title: Lv.4 及物動詞「零介係詞 Ø」陷阱與對照（衝刺 900+ 分）
levels.desc: 6 個中文直譯陷阱（須用 Ø 球）混搭 6 個近義真介係詞，內含干擾球 about！

items.meaning: 討論（及物動詞，不加 about）
items.example: Let us discuss the quarterly budget before Friday's meeting.
items.note: discuss 本身含「談論關於」，加 about 為經典文法錯誤。

trapHints.about: 陷阱！discuss 為及物動詞，不可加 about，請改用 Ø 球！

items.example: Please contact the regional manager if the shipment is late.
items.note: 名詞才說 have contact with；動詞直接用 contact + 人。

trapHints.with: 陷阱！contact 作「動詞」直接接受詞，不可加 with，改用 Ø！

items.meaning: 與…溝通（對照組：需加 with）
items.example: We communicate with overseas partners via video calls.
items.note: 對比 contact：communicate 表雙向溝通需配 with。

trapHints.Ø: communicate 表「與某人溝通」時為不及物動詞，須配 with！

items.meaning: 出席（直接接活動，不加 at/to）
items.example: All department heads are required to attend the morning briefing.
items.note: 表「出席會議/課程」時為及物動詞。

trapHints.to: 表「出席活動」直接用 attend + 活動（Ø 球）；attend to 才是「照料/處理」！

items.example: Ms. Lin will attend to urgent customer orders this afternoon.
items.note: 與 attend + 會議 區分：attend to 意指處理事務或服務賓客。

trapHints.Ø: 這裡是「處理急件」不是「出席」，固定片語為 attend to！

items.meaning: 等候（await = wait for，不加 for）
items.example: The construction team is awaiting final city approval.
items.note: 正式書信常用 await + 名詞，不可重複加 for。

trapHints.for: 陷阱！await 已包含 for 的語意（= wait for），不可加 for，用 Ø！

items.example: Applicants must wait for written confirmation by email.
items.note: 對比 await：wait 後接等待對象須配 for。

trapHints.Ø: wait 為不及物動詞，等待某事物須配 for！

items.meaning: 抵達／達成（及物動詞，不加 at/to）
items.example: Our delivery van should reach the warehouse before noon.
items.note: reach a destination / reach an agreement 皆直接接受詞。

trapHints.at: 陷阱！arrive 才配 at，reach 為及物動詞不加 at，改用 Ø！
trapHints.to: 陷阱！reach 直接接受詞，不加 to，改用 Ø！

items.meaning: 抵達小地點（對照組：須配 at）
items.example: Visitors should arrive at the reception desk fifteen minutes early.
items.note: 大城市/國家用 in，機場/車站/會場等點狀場所用 at。

trapHints.Ø: arrive 為不及物動詞，抵達會場須配 at！
trapHints.to: arrive 絕不搭配 to！小地點請用 at。

items.example: The CEO emphasized product quality during the annual speech.
items.note: 名詞 put emphasis on 才加 on，動詞 emphasize 直接接受詞！

trapHints.on: 陷阱！名詞 emphasis 才配 on，動詞 emphasize 直接接受詞（Ø）！

items.example: Our quality control team insists on inspecting every batch.
items.note: 後接名詞或動名詞，固定搭配 on。

trapHints.Ø: insist 後接堅持的項目時為不及物，須搭配 on！

items.meaning: 尋找（不加 for 會變「搜查某人」）
items.example: Procurement is searching for a more reliable packaging supplier.
items.note: search + 場所/人 = 搜查；search for + 目標 = 尋找。

trapHints.Ø: search + 某人/處是「搜查/搜身」；表「尋找」必須搭配 for！
